name: Email Auto Classification
description: AI-powered email classification with automatic actions (archive, forward, notify)
explanation:
This workflow automates email classification and processing using AI.

Key features:
- Schedule trigger: Runs every 15 minutes (configurable)
- ForEach loop: Processes each email individually
- AI classification: Categorizes emails into spam, support, invoice, general
- IMAP actions: Move to folders, mark as read
- SMTP forwarding: Forward support emails with prefix
- Telegram notification: Alert for invoice emails

Workflow structure:
[Start/Schedule] → [IMAP Read] → [While (ForEach)] → [End]
                                        ↓ Loop Tools
                                   [AI] → [If/Else]
                                              ├─ spam → [IMAP Move (Spam)]
                                              ├─ support → [SMTP Forward] → [IMAP markRead]
                                              ├─ invoice → [Telegram] → [IMAP markRead]
                                              └─ general (else) → [IMAP Move (General)]

Gmail optimization:
- Auto-maps folder names (Spam → [Gmail]/Spam)
- Uses X-GM-LABELS for label management

General IMAP support (Zoho, Outlook, Hostpoint, etc.):
- Automatic folder name resolution
- UID re-search for moved emails
- Rate limiting delay for stability

Setup required:
1. Configure IMAP/SMTP connection in Connections
2. (Optional) Set up Telegram bot for invoice alerts
3. Customize AI classification rules if needed
4. Enable schedule trigger when ready
